trigger: armed_before_step and dot(g_new,v)>=0; arm on P<0; cap regardless of arming
timing_horizon: through diagnostic sustained 1e-10 crossing, or full budget if censored
meaningful_gain: at least 20% lower median gradient work AND median optimizer wall time at 1e-8 versus RHGD; report AGD/CAGD separately; no >25% regression on exact or weak
stress_cases: mechanism diagnostics only: diagonal [5e-5,5,500] with x=[1,1,0] and slow-only [1,0,0]; 32 logspaced eigenvalues 5e-5 to 500 with x=ones; 20000 updates each
cache_policy: literal gradient calls; no gradient caching for any method
no_variants: no rollback, deadband, added line search, Bernoulli fallback, A or C hybrid
allocation_ceiling: one CPU; probe 2 minutes plus main 20 minutes; no automatic resubmission
